text.card: CoRoT-7 b crosses CoRoT-7 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.

quotes.title: CoRoT-7
quotes.card: CoRoT-7 is a binary star system made up of a late G-type star and a M-dwarf star that was discovered in 2021.
quotes.introduction: The primary star has three exoplanets, including CoRoT-7b, a super-Earth exoplanet that is remarkable due to its extremely high temperature and very short orbital period, around 20 hours.

notes: CoRoT-7 c: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
